theorems.name: Submission.variation_matrix_det_hasDerivAt_leibniz
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (G : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ) (H : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (x : ℝ), (∀ i k, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ G s i k) (H i k) x) → HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ (G t).det) (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∑ m : ι, (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, G x (σ j) j) * H (σ m) m) x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
